content: Advanced wound therapies, as recognized by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), involve the use of specialized techniques and materials to promote optimal wound healing. These therapies include the application of cellular matrix tissues, which provide a scaffold to support cellular growth and tissue regeneration. Additionally, various xenograft tissues, derived from non-human species, and allograft tissues, sourced from human donors, are utilized to reinforce and support the structural integrity of damaged tissues.
